mapper.select: SELECT ad.admin_dong_id, ad.dong_population, ad.dong_area, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'SUBWAY_STATION' THEN 1 END) AS subway_station_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'BUS_STOP' THEN 1 END) AS bus_stop_count FROM admin_dongs ad LEFT JOIN places p ON p.admin_dong_id = ad.admin_dong_id AND p.category IN ('SUBWAY_STATION', 'BUS_STOP') GROUP BY ad.admin_dong_id, ad.dong_population, ad.dong_area
mapper.insert:
